LingoSpark pack LS-8-HOME
Ósmoklasista: Miejsce zamieszkania — 119 haseł do gier LingoSpark

119 terms in 6 sets (A, B, C, D, E, F).

1. Open print/teacher-guide.html and print/student-worksheets.html in a browser.
2. Ctrl+P → Save as PDF (TPT wants PDF).
3. Upload the PDFs + the paste/ folder as a ZIP.
4. Play: copy paste/set-A-pl.txt → https://lingospark.study → Vocab Review → Bomb Defusal.
